provenance: Halloran commissioned the Gadfly rebuild after losing Vespers it could not readily replace. Recovered Compact roots received Sarn plate and practical spotting equipment.
serviceHistory: The compromise became common because it suited work that was already being done: checking cuts before a convoy entered them, finding a firing position for a battery and keeping an eye on the next ridge. The open lifting frame above the cab is as characteristic as the patched plate beneath it.

Gadfly crews are usually known to the workshops along their route. A fitter who recognises the driver's family is more likely to keep a late shift for a damaged leg. Halloran calls this local support. The driver calls it owing somebody another favour. Neither arrangement appears on an Aurelian service certificate.
fieldNotes: The standard fit helps a scout mark trouble and leave it to the heavier machines. Jump equipment opens escape routes, but light armour still makes a prolonged exchange expensive. A captured emitter can replace local armament where the mount accepts it; the company then inherits its cooling and supply problem.
